_comment: Optional tuning. Anything you put under 'weights' is merged over the built-in
defaults, so list only what you want to change — leave the rest out and it keeps
following the app. Set a name to 0 to switch that behaviour off entirely.

On a perch:  patrol idle sit camouflage peek hang swing climb climbDown slide leave
